QuestInfo.name: [Karote] A Gate to Distant Lands
QuestInfo.2:
#b#p3005210##k said it was his #bfather#k's wish to watch #bKarote#k reach its peak, and offered to guide you there.
You and the Alliance approached the tower with the help of #bArchelon#k, who has awakened as an ancient god.
You arrived just in time to watch the tower fall.
